card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 12 Pro that is not charging and touch not working

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 12 Pro that is not charging and touch not working

claims.statement: iPhone 12-series no charge plus no touch is often a failed USB (Kraken) IC, commonly after poor chargers.
On a DC supply the phone may power but not see USB, with an irregular spike when prompted to boot.
Fix: split the sandwich and replace the Kraken IC (reballed or new).

procedure: Test known-good charge port flex and battery.
Inspect the USB IC area for liquid or damage.
Check DCPS draw on power-up for irregular spikes.
Separate the sandwich and replace the Kraken IC; test charge and touch.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
